fusions.name: Hoodwink
fusions.desc: Looses 3 blindfold strips at once, each dealing 6 damage and stunning what it hits for 0.8 seconds, with a 50% chance to leave it [Blunted] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Loose Thread
fusions.desc: Pulls a loose thread in an enemy at or below 25% health up to 7 tiles away, dealing 28 damage, up to 1.2 times as much at full reach.

fusions.name: Blindfolded Sight
fusions.desc: Ties a blindfold over your eyes and raises your critical hit chance by 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Embroidered Charm
fusions.desc: Conjures a charm embroidered with an open eye: your critical chance rises by 6%, your critical hits deal 15% more damage, and each kill returns 2 health.
